B.E. Computer Science and Engineering — Syllabus 2024 Pattern

The following syllabus applies to students admitted to the B.E. Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) program at Walchand College of Engineering under the 2024 course pattern, as approved by Shivaji University and AICTE.

Semester I (First Year Engineering — Common)

  • Engineering Mathematics I (4 credits)
  • Engineering Physics (3 credits)
  • Engineering Chemistry (3 credits)
  • Basic Electrical Engineering (3 credits)
  • Engineering Graphics (3 credits)
  • Workshop Practice (2 credits)

Semester II (First Year Engineering — Common)

  • Engineering Mathematics II (4 credits)
  • Programming in C (4 credits)
  • Engineering Mechanics (3 credits)
  • Environmental Studies (2 credits)
  • Communication Skills (2 credits)
  • Engineering Drawing (2 credits)

Semester III (Second Year CSE)

  • Data Structures and Algorithms (4 credits)
  • Discrete Mathematics (4 credits)
  • Digital Electronics (3 credits)
  • Object-Oriented Programming with Java (4 credits)
  • Computer Organisation (3 credits)
  • DSA Lab (2 credits)
  • OOP Lab (2 credits)

Semester IV (Second Year CSE)

  • Analysis of Algorithms (4 credits)
  • Database Management Systems (4 credits)
  • Operating Systems (4 credits)
  • Microprocessors and Interfacing (3 credits)
  • DBMS Lab (2 credits)
  • OS Lab (2 credits)
  • Mini Project — I (2 credits)

Semester V (Third Year CSE)

  • Computer Networks (4 credits)
  • Software Engineering (4 credits)
  • Theory of Computation (4 credits)
  • Elective I: Machine Learning / Cloud Computing / IoT (3 credits)
  • Networks Lab (2 credits)
  • SE Lab (2 credits)
  • Mini Project — II (2 credits)

Semester VI (Third Year CSE)

  • Compiler Design (4 credits)
  • Information Security (4 credits)
  • Web Technologies (4 credits)
  • Elective II: Deep Learning / Blockchain / Cyber Security (3 credits)
  • Web Tech Lab (2 credits)
  • Security Lab (2 credits)
  • Seminar (2 credits)

Semester VII (Final Year CSE)

  • Artificial Intelligence (4 credits)
  • Distributed Systems (4 credits)
  • Elective III: Natural Language Processing / Computer Vision / Edge Computing (3 credits)
  • Project Phase I (6 credits)
  • Professional Ethics (2 credits)

Semester VIII (Final Year CSE)

  • Elective IV: Big Data Analytics / Quantum Computing (3 credits)
  • Project Phase II (10 credits)
  • Industrial Training / Internship (4 credits)
  • Comprehensive Viva (2 credits)

Examination Pattern

Each theory course is evaluated as follows:

  • In-Semester Assessment (ISA): 40 marks (two class tests of 20 marks each)
  • End-Semester Examination (ESE): 60 marks (university examination)
  • Practical / Lab: 25 marks internal + 25 marks external = 50 marks
  • Minimum passing marks: 40% in ESE and 40% aggregate (ISA + ESE combined)
